formula: z(native_scores) + weight * z(attribute_scores), where z standardizes each image across the same 75 candidate classes with population standard deviation, floor 1e-8.
selection: For each variant and fold, maximize mean GZSL H across all three fixed training seeds on the other four folds. Ties within 1e-10 choose the smaller weight. Use the same chosen weight for all three seeds on the held-out fold. Primary metrics pool out-of-fold predictions. Full-development fixed-weight curves are descriptive only.
controls: Zero weight must exactly preserve native predictions. All six branches receive the same fusion search. Learned_part and wrong_part share localization training and readout budgets; other branches lack the additional localization training.
scope: Previously reused development data only: 50 seen and 25 development-unseen classes, 500 images. No model updates, image filtering, final-set access, new backbone, per-class weights, or post-result expansion of the search. Cross-fitting does not undo earlier development-set reuse.
uncertainty: Paired class-bootstrap intervals condition on the trained models and selected out-of-fold predictions; they do not repeat weight selection or represent an independent confirmatory test.
